prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1407; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the nature and force of the collision. Examination findings showed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted range of motion in the cervical and lumbar regions, and imaging studies clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to both areas. No prior injury or treatment to the same body regions is known to this provider. Care was delivered over three visits consisting of evaluation, manual therapy, and a home stretching program, following a typical course for this type of strain. Symptoms improved steadily with each visit, and treatment was tapered accordingly as function returned. Billing records reflect single charges for each service, with no duplicate or repeated billing. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise, and the patient was discharged to follow up as needed.
